repos.name: tumor_detection
repos.description: Deep learning pipeline that classifies brain MRI scans as healthy or tumor. It benchmarks classical ML, custom CNNs with CBAM attention, transfer learning (DenseNet-121, ResNet-50) and a Vision Transformer, and explains predictions with Grad-CAM.

repos.name: Sign-Language-Detection
repos.description: An AI-powered sign language detection system that analyzes hand gestures and movements in real time to translate them into text or speech. It uses computer vision models and deep learning networks to recognize signs, provide a smooth user interface.
